translate_en|mods/RealWater/42/media/lua: Too far from the edge to reach.
Seconds a swimmer going under can hold their breath before losing health.
A river's current carries swimmers along and pulls at the legs of anyone wading. Off lets everyone hold their place in the water.
In single player, floating items and bodies drift with the current and the wind, and anyone in the water pushes them aside. Off keeps them where they fell.
Health a swimmer loses every second once their breath runs out.
A swimmer who runs out of endurance starts going under, and once their breath runs out loses health until they get back to where they can stand. Off lets an exhausted swimmer stay afloat.
Players can walk into rivers, lakes and ponds and swim where it is too deep to stand. Off keeps everyone out of the water like the base game.
Ponds with fewer water squares than this are too shallow to swim in. Pools, fountains and canals stay deep at the edge. 0 lets every pond get deep in the middle.
A swimmer can't aim, attack, shove or grab, and can't do any action but moving items and walking. Off lets swimmers do whatever they can on land.
How much endurance swimming and treading water cost, in percent of the normal cost. Only used while Swimming Tires is on.
Swimming wears endurance down, treading water too. Off leaves only the game's own cost of running and sprinting.
Seconds a floating vehicle takes to fill with water and sink.
Seconds a vehicle can stand under 1 m of water before it is wrecked for good.

In single player, cars can drive into lakes and rivers. They slow down as it gets deeper, stall once the water reaches 0.6 m, and are wrecked for good after the Vehicle Wreck Time under 1 m of water. Off keeps them out of the water.
Wading slows players and zombies down the deeper the water gets, with no sprinting past the knees and no running past the waist. Off lets everyone wade at their usual pace.
The water soaks the body and clothes as far up as it reaches, so the Wet moodle rises with the depth and a swimmer ends up drenched. Off leaves getting wet to the rain.
The water washes dirt and blood off the skin and clothes under it. Off leaves them as dirty as they were.
Seconds a zombie can walk along the bottom with the water over its head before it drowns.
A zombie walking along the bottom with the water over its head drowns after the Zombie Drown Time. Off keeps it walking until it comes out.
How many zombies in a hundred follow into the water. The rest stop at the edge. Zombies can't swim, so where it's too deep they keep walking along the bottom.
A zombie following someone into a pool, or off a pier or a canal wall, trips, falls in and dies. Off: it steps down into the water.
With Visceral World, blood in the water spreads out and drifts with the moving water. Off leaves it to Visual Expansion's blood clouds, or to the game.
Bubbles rise from anyone under the water and burst on the surface. Off shows no bubbles.
Light bent by the waves plays in bright lines over whatever lies under the water. Off lights the bottom evenly.
Water drips off anyone who is wet near the water and rings it where it lands. Off stops the drips.
Fish swim under the surface where the water holds them, and scatter from anyone nearby. Off shows no fish.
Bodies in the water float low with the back at the surface and bob on it. Off leaves them lying still on top of the water.
White foam gathers where the water breaks: round anyone in it, in wakes and on breaking waves. Off leaves the water clear.
The sun and moon glitter on the waves, and crests catch the light. Off leaves the waves lit evenly.
Wood and empty bottles float on the water, clothes and paper float until they soak through, and the rest sinks to the bottom. Off leaves items lying still on top of the water.
With Build Your Own Kayak, kayaks ride the waves and push the water aside. Off leaves kayakers to that mod.
Rain puddles and wet ground thin out before the water's edge instead of stopping in square teeth along diagonal banks and canal walls. Off leaves the game's puddles.
Each raindrop rings the moving water where it lands. Off leaves the game's own rain ripples.
People, zombies, trees and buildings by the water show upside down in it, broken up by the waves. Off shows only the sky's reflection.
What is under the surface, such as the legs of someone wading, shows through the water, bent and tinted by it. Off covers it with the water's colour.
Splashes throw drops and mist into the air that fall back into the water. Off keeps the water from splashing up.
The water moves: waves spread from anyone wading or swimming and from rain, and run out against the banks. Off leaves only the game's own ripples, and the wave, Spray and Drips options do nothing.
Anyone wading or swimming pushes the water aside and leaves a wake behind. Off lets them pass without stirring it.
Rivers, lakes and ponds show their bed through the water: sand and stones in the shallows, darker and greener further out, with sunlight rippling on the bottom. Off keeps the game's water colour.
The bank is dark and glossy just above the waterline, where the soil soaks the water up. Off leaves the bank dry up to the water.
Characters look darker where the water reached them, and all over in the rain, then dry out over a few minutes. Off keeps them looking dry.
The wind raises waves on open water, bigger the harder it blows and the more open water it crosses. Off keeps open water calm.
